title: Wagetype Leaves — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: Which wagetypes make up the pay for a type of leave. Leave pay, the value of accrued leave and the annual leave provision all add up the monthly amounts of the wagetypes listed here for that leave type.

fields.label: WageTypeId
fields.rules: Required. Chosen from Wage Type master data.
fields.html:
What it is. A wagetype included in the pay for this leave.

Example. Housing Allowance

fields.label: AbsenceTypeId
fields.rules: Required. Chosen from Leave Type master data.
fields.html:
What it is. The type of leave.

Example. Annual Leave

Why it matters. Each wagetype can be listed only once for a leave type.
